title: ‘Disgusting, shameless’: Jr NTR slams Chuttamalle deepfake of Janhvi Kapoor, vows legal action
key_facts: Telugu film star Jr NTR condemned an AI-generated deepfake video that uses footage of the 'Chuttamalle' song from his 2024 film Devara: Part 1 to show co-star Janhvi Kapoor in a sexually explicit way.
He posted on X on Saturday (3 Oct 2026), opening with 'Disgusting. Sick. Shameless.'
He said he will take every possible legal action against those who made the video and those who spread it.
He asked the public not to watch or share such content and urged Indian state governments and the central government to bring strict regulation against misuse of AI.
The Indian Express notes earlier cases: Rashmika Mandanna was targeted by a viral deepfake in November 2023; Kajol, Alia Bhatt and Katrina Kaif have also been subjects of manipulated content.
quote_evidence: "To the scumbags behind this morphed Chuttamalle video, I will not spare any of you. I will take every possible legal action against those who created it and those who are spreading it," he wrote.
"This is a serious issue, and I urge all the state governments and the Government of India to act strongly and bring in strict regulations against the misuse of AI," he wrote.
why_it_matters_hint: A major Indian film star publicly demanding legal action and AI regulation over a non-consensual deepfake of a co-star, adding to a series of such cases.
notes: Public X post reported directly by The Indian Express; no legal filing reported yet, only a stated intention.
